what: Checks on the raw frames for md/RESULTS.md (solute frames). Written by md/production/site_checks.py; own reading of the DCD files, set beside the series of the two analysis programs.

threshold.what: solute frames, equilibration and production, whose value lies within the tolerance of a threshold (SPEC.md, section 14): d1 6.7 A, d2 5.2 A, N2...OG1(Thr199) 3.5 A (0.001 A each), N2-H...OG1 135 deg (0.01 deg), nearer sulfonyl oxygen to the zinc 2.6 A (0.001 A), |signed volume at N2| below 0.001

his64.what: Zn to NE2(His64) and chi1 (N-CA-CB-CG); 'deep in' = chi1 between 0 and 120 deg with the distance at most the limit; shares in per cent of the solute frames of the production from 20 to 100 ns

departures.what: means over the solute frames of the production; the zinc out of the plane of the His119 ring (least-squares plane of CG, ND1, CD2, CE1, NE2) is the mean of the signed distance, given without its sign, and the mean of the unsigned distance beside it

nitrogen.what: signed volume V at N2 (Zn, H, S) and the sum of the three angles at N2

ligand_against_the_docked_rotated_pose.what: RMSD of the 11 heavy atoms of the ligand to md/system/ligand_R.pdb after the fit of the CA atoms on reference.pdb, smallest of the four equivalent labellings
